scripts.build: npm --prefix Frontend/vite-project run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');function cp(s,d){fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const e of fs.readdirSync(s,{withFileTypes:true})){const sp=path.join(s,e.name),dp=path.join(d,e.name);e.isDirectory()?cp(sp,dp):fs.copyFileSync(sp,dp)}}cp('Frontend/vite-project/dist','backend/public');console.log('Build complete and synced to backend/public');"
